Line.Text: You are already halfway down the stairs by the time that he utters that. It doesn't take him long to recognize the futility of saying anything further.

Actions.Title: Uh-oh
Actions.Message:
He really does yap too much, doesn't he? Who knew that French romance comes with this much baggage?

If you want to try again, first exit Kweebdrasil, then reset your progress by running the command /clearkweebdrasilprogress.
